output_semantics.usage: IDMS retrieval COBOL to DB2 embedded SQL conversion
output_semantics.foreign_key_rule: Use SET relationship and owner primary key columns only.
output_semantics.character_rule: CHAR by default; VARCHAR only when length equals 100.
output_semantics.numeric_rule: Numeric COBOL PIC maps to DECIMAL.
output_semantics.date_rule: Date part recognition remains generic for YEAR, YR, Y, YY, YYYY, DY, MONTH, MON, MO, M, MM, DM, DAY, D, DD.
